assignedTasks.title: Vite React + Tailwind Project Initialization
assignedTasks.description:
Set up the 'frontend' directory. Requirements:
1. Initialize Vite React template.
2. Install Tailwind V3, configure deep dark palette (Surface Dark: #0D0D0D).
3. Setup React Router DOM, Zustand (state).
4. Implement basic directory structure (components, pages, store, api).
5. Add PWA manifest file placeholder.

assignedTasks.title: Node/Express Server Initialization
assignedTasks.description:
Set up the 'backend' directory. Requirements:
1. Initialize Node/Express project.
2. Configure basic middleware (cors, express.json, helmet).
3. Set up MongoDB + Mongoose connection boilerplate.
4. Attach Socket.io server to the HTTP instance.
5. Standardize error handling middleware.

assignedTasks.title: API Routes: Topics & Rooms
assignedTasks.description:
Create the REST endpoints to feed the Frontend. Requirements:
1. GET /api/topics (Returns list of topics with timer data and category filtering).
2. POST /api/topics (Create new topic).
3. GET /api/topics/:id (Get topic details and initial message payload).
4. Include Mock Data script if DB isn't ready.

assignedTasks.title: Socket.io Client Integration
assignedTasks.description:
Connect the React frontend to the Node Socket.io server. Requirements:
1. Establish connection on successful auth/load.
2. Subscribe to 'room_join', 'new_message', and 'new_reaction' events.
3. Integrate with Zustand store to optimistically update the UI.
